title: Wso2am: Netty allows request-line validation to be bypassed when a `DefaultHttpRequest` or `DefaultFullHttpRequest` is…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package involves Netty's request-line validation being bypassed when a DefaultHttpRequest or DefaultFullHttpRequest object is created and its URI is subsequently changed via the setUri() method. This flaw allows modification of the request URI after initial validation, potentially leading to improper request handling.
